description: Return the whole /trust.json agent trust checklist for agentpaywire.com. Output includes title, description, free_data, items, count (items.length), tools, errors, wallet_error_codes, rate_limits, credits, urls, error_body, usage, and authorization. Each item has id, title, status (met or partial), statement, and evidence URLs. tools lists the advertised MCP tool names. rate_limits.http_429 is true and rate_limits.client is null. Feedback and review caps are HTTP 429 with Retry-After (feedback_rate_limited, review_rate_limited). A Lightning wallet rate limit, a store failure (feedback_store, review_store, review_rpc), and a rate-limited deep health probe stay HTTP 503. credits repeats price_sats, credits, and ttl_days. One unpaged document. Takes no parameters: call with an empty object. Use get_trust_checklist instead of get_support_info when you need error codes, the rate-limit policy, stable URLs, credit terms, or met/partial status. Use get_support_info instead when you need donation addresses, payment URIs, QR links, or the paid_api price block. Use get_protocol_facts instead for third-party protocol facts. A failed read returns isError. The text is the Error message (Fetch failed <status> <url> when the HTTP status is not OK), or Trust checklist failed. when the failure is not an Error. Free, no auth.
name: get_trust_checklist
title: Read the trust checklist
